messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?
Thanks. I don’t know what price A is proposing or what the house is worth. I want a fair financial share and won’t subsidize a discounted purchase. I’d like us to settle it, but there’s no rush.

We don’t have a proposed price or a current valuation yet, and the shares and division of the estate haven’t been decided. I’d like to buy the house with my husband, ideally at a family discount, but I know C hasn’t agreed.

I’d like to see the house dealt with fairly, though I’m not sure the details are settled. Some money from the estate would help me get a dance studio started, but I don’t have an urgent financial need.
I don’t object to getting an independent appraisal. I’m not sure what the will says about shares—we should check it.
I don’t object to an independent appraisal. I’m not sure what the will says about the shares.
I agree to one independent appraisal, with the cost split three ways. I don’t know whether the will is on hand; we’ll need to check and locate it if not.
I don’t know where the will is. I can check Dad’s papers.
If the will is hard to find, perhaps we should get proper advice before assuming how the shares are divided. I’d appreciate an update on the timing once there’s more clarity.
Yes, that covers it. Add that I haven’t agreed to a sale; we should settle the shares first, and any buyout must give me a fair financial share. I’m not in a rush.
